gen.title: Recommended funding order from free aid to loans
gen.orderNote: Follow the suggested order from lowest cost aid to higher cost borrowing

steps.label: Research options that avoid loans
steps.quote: It’s important to first research how you can pay for college without loans.

steps.label: Apply for grants and scholarships
steps.quote: Grants and scholarships are a type of financial aid that doesn’t have to be repaid.

steps.label: Use federal student loans next
steps.quote: Federal student loans are made and guaranteed by the Department of Education

steps.label: Consider private loans last
steps.quote: including applying for the maximum federal student loans you’re eligible for, before shopping for a private student loan.
steps.orderHint: Shop private only at the end
